# go-chi

chi router idioms the Go adapter reads: r.Method, r.Get/r.Post, middleware via r.Use, and the stdlib net/http contract underneath.

## Recipes

- `apiforge plan architecture --path <dump-or-project>`
- `apiforge knowledge show go-chi`
- `apiforge judge` then filter findings by rules (none declared)
